{{popupType}} Data Retrieval File for Vendor

Use this page to add a file to the Data Retrieval specifications for a Vendor.

Vendor Report Name is required
Vendor File Name is required
Maximum length for the Vendor File Name is 75 characters
Short Name is required
Required is required
Description is required
Maximum length for the Description is 200 characters
In zip? is required
Status is required
Retrieval Method is required
File Type is required
Column Headers is required
{{columnHeaderAdd}} Expected Column Headers

Use the Data Retrieval Import Template to indicate all Column Headers expected on the file. Population of this template is required to add a file when "Column Headers Expected" equals "Yes."

Click the "Download blank template'" link below to download a blank template. Once you have populated the template with the expected headers, use the field below to locate and select the populated template file. Click the "Upload" button to initiate the upload
